name: schaff_trend_cycle
status: research settings, not approved trading settings

formula.input: close prices of exactly 192 trailing closed bars ending at the endpoint t (rows t-191 .. t)
formula.ema: for each endpoint t, ema(t-191) = close(t-191); then ema(k) = alpha * close(k) + (1 - alpha) * ema(k-1) with alpha = 2 / (period + 1), for the fast and the slow period separately
formula.macd: macd(k) = fast_ema(k) - slow_ema(k); the first slow_period - 1 samples of the replay are discarded
formula.stoch1_raw: for every complete inclusive cycle_length window of kept macd samples: 100 * (macd(k) - min) / (max - min)
formula.stoch1: s1 = stoch1_raw at the first complete window; then s1(k) = s1(k-1) + smoothing * (stoch1_raw(k) - s1(k-1))
formula.stoch2_raw: for every complete inclusive cycle_length window of s1: 100 * (s1(k) - min) / (max - min)
formula.oscillator: stc = stoch2_raw at the first complete window of s1; then stc(k) = stc(k-1) + smoothing * (stoch2_raw(k) - stc(k-1)); the endpoint value is stc at row t
formula.zero_range: max - min that is not strictly positive in any normalization window of the endpoint replay invalidates that endpoint (reason zero_range); no carried value and no zero oscillator is substituted
formula.previous_endpoint: the endpoint t-1 is calculated independently from its own 192 bars (rows t-192 .. t-1)
formula.long_entry: stc(t-1) <= lower_threshold and stc(t) > lower_threshold and macd(t) > macd(t-1)
formula.short_entry: stc(t-1) >= upper_threshold and stc(t) < upper_threshold and macd(t) < macd(t-1)
formula.slope_disagrees: a threshold crossing whose macd endpoint change is zero or has the wrong sign holds
formula.required_history: 193 valid consecutive closed bars at the declared bar cadence; this fits the ordinary 200-row check window for every supported parameter set
formula.input_validity: inside rows t-192 .. t: finite positive open, high, low and close, low <= open, close <= high, finite volume >= 0, a timestamp on every row, strictly increasing timestamps spaced exactly at the declared cadence (frame attribute bar_interval_ms), and no row that was received out of order
formula.runtime_freshness: only a Hyperliquid check-time frame carries a decision_time attribute; its last row is fresh only when the selected closed bar boundary equals the row boundary and 0 <= cutoff - boundary < interval; an untimed check-time frame has no cutoff and holds (decision_time_missing); historical frames have no attribute and use each row's own boundary
formula.reason_priority: frame defects (missing_columns, missing_cadence, missing_timestamps); else the latest row or timestamp defect in rows t-192 .. t (nonfinite_input, nonpositive_price, invalid_candle_geometry, negative_volume, missing_timestamps, timestamp_order, cadence_gap); else insufficient_history; else nonfinite_derived; else zero_range; else, on the last check-time row only, decision_time_missing, decision_boundary_mismatch, decision_bar_future, decision_bar_stale; else entry_long, entry_short, slope_disagrees or no_cross
formula.invalid_value_representation: invalid values are NaN in the evaluator frame and are omitted from check output; validity flags are 0.0 or 1.0

selection.eligible: complete candle and funding coverage, every dataset scored, no liquidated leg, at least min_train_independent_positions independent positions

base.meaning: manifest fees, per-coin half spread and slippage

stress.meaning: manifest fees unchanged, half spread and slippage doubled

continuous_reference.definition: the same equations evaluated once over the whole manifest frame (EMAs seeded at the first frame close, normalizations from the first complete window); a zero normalization range carries the previous normalized value, which is the conventional continuous-history treatment
continuous_reference.scope: selected schaff_both parameters, every dataset, both windows, scored rows only

mismatch_classes.finite_zero_range_hold: the finite endpoint holds on zero_range while the continuous calculation emits an entry
mismatch_classes.seed_divergence: both calculations are valid and their decisions differ because the finite replay restarts its recursions 192 bars back

continuous_reference.acceptance: every decision mismatch must fall in a listed class; an unclassified mismatch makes the study inconclusive

verdict.inconclusive: any coverage refusal, no eligible training selection for an arm, a held-out sample gate that fails, or an unclassified continuous-reference mismatch
verdict.pass: complete coverage, every sample gate met, both candidate arms net PnL > 0 at base and stress cost, and the matched long-only candidate base mean Sharpe and base mean drawdown-adjusted return both strictly above each selected comparator
verdict.fail: a complete study that misses any pass condition
verdict.edge_status: a pass keeps edge_status=no_edge with edge_source unvalidated; a fail records study_fail and an inconclusive result records study_inconclusive, identically in Go and Python

cache_legs: none; the study uses only the hash-pinned Hyperliquid venue manifest, so no Binance US proxy leg and no --funding cache option is used
